title: I think AI is more useful for TradingView coding than prediction
author: Jealous_Win2699
selftext:
I've been thinking about where AI actually makes sense in a trading workflow.

Personally, I find the coding side more interesting than asking AI to predict prices.

For example:

Trading idea → natural language → Pine Script → TradingView → backtest.

I recently found a tool built around this workflow:  
[https://tradingviewai.dev/](https://tradingviewai.dev/)

It doesn't mean the generated strategy is good. You still need to validate everything yourself.

But reducing the time between having an idea and being able to backtest it seems genuinely useful.

What do you think?
